requirements.title: COUNT arguments satisfy MASK, DIM, and KIND restrictions
requirements.definition: MASK shall be a logical array; optional DIM shall be an integer scalar in range 1 through the rank n of MASK and its corresponding actual argument shall not be an optional dummy argument, disassociated pointer, or unallocated allocatable; optional KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.count-mask-logical-array: Positive-control source plan calls COUNT with logical rank-one and rank-two arrays. Wrong-type MASK has no diagnostic facet in this unnumbered argument rule.
pending.count-dim-integer-scalar-in-range: Positive-control plan uses DIM=1 and DIM=2 on a rank-two MASK and mutates DIM between the two to make the resulting shape/value checks fail.
pending.count-dim-actual-present-associated-allo: Future source-control plan passes an ordinary present scalar DIM variable; optional, pointer, and allocatable actual edge cases are left as source restrictions with no diagnostic facet here.
pending.count-kind-scalar-integer-constant: Positive-control plan uses KIND=selected_int_kind(18) or KIND(0) as a scalar integer constant expression and asserts the result kind; nonconstant KIND has no diagnostic facet in this unnumbered rule.

requirements.title: COUNT result has specified integer kind, rank, and shape
requirements.definition: The COUNT result is integer; KIND selects the kind type parameter when present, otherwise default integer is used; the result is scalar if DIM is absent or n equals one, otherwise rank n-1 with the DIM extent removed from MASK's shape.

pending.count-result-integer: Assign COUNT output to an integer result initialized to a nonzero sentinel and use KIND/type-compatible checks; a non-integer replacement expression must fail compilation of the control harness, not be a test oracle here.
pending.count-result-kind-selected: Call COUNT with KIND=selected_int_kind(18), store KIND(result) into a sentinel-initialized integer, and assert it equals selected_int_kind(18), whose availability is required for the suite's supported processors by the integer range minimum noted in the project precedents.
pending.count-result-kind-default: Call COUNT without KIND and assert KIND(result) equals KIND(0), with the observed kind initialized to -777 first.
pending.count-result-scalar-without-dim-or-rank-: Use a rank-one MASK with both true and false values and assert scalar assignment succeeds and yields the exact count; mutate by adding DIM to a rank-two case to change rank.
pending.count-result-rank-and-shape-with-dim: Use a rank-two MASK of shape [2,3], assert SHAPE(COUNT(MASK,DIM=1)) is [3] and SHAPE(COUNT(MASK,DIM=2)) is [2], with nonzero extents and value checks.

requirements.title: COUNT result values equal true-element counts
requirements.definition: With DIM absent or rank-one MASK, the value is the number of true elements or zero for size zero; with DIM present and rank greater than one, each result element is the number of true elements along the selected dimension section.

pending.count-rank-one-true-elements: Use [.true., .false., .true., .false.] and expect 2; mutate the MASK pattern and the COUNT call independently so a wrong count is load-bearing.
pending.count-size-zero-mask-zero: Use a zero-size logical array and a companion nonzero-size mask in the same fixture; assert the zero-size result is 0 and the companion count is nonzero to avoid vacuous zero-only coverage.
pending.count-dim-present-section-counts: Use a 2x3 logical mask with different counts in each row and column; assert exact DIM=1 and DIM=2 vectors so swapping DIM is detected.
